title: PitchForge IPC contract
description: Source of truth for the server<->UI boundary (CLAUDE.md §9). Both the TypeScript client in /app/ipc and the server-side handlers are generated from this file. Edit this, never the generated output. Use the /api command.
notes: M0: the contract is empty by design. The server does not exist until M3; inventing endpoint shapes before there is a server to serve them would be a contract we cannot honour.
Version negotiation is the one thing that must exist from the start: a client and server that disagree on contractVersion must refuse to talk rather than silently misinterpret a payload.
